title: Positive ramification subsequence
statement: For a natural number $e\ge1$, define the order embedding $r_e:\mathbf N\hookrightarrow\mathbf N$ by $r_e(n)=e(n+1)-1$. Thus zero-based index $n$ records positive exponent $n+1$, and this embedding selects precisely positive exponents divisible by $e$. The strict-monotonicity witness is the canonical arithmetic proof. This defines the subsequence only and makes no assertion about recovery of coefficient systems.
